caption: Right after signup the inbox shows our free trial: it ends in 30 days.
The cheapest plan, Basic, costs €4 a month for 1 user and 5 GB. It only works in Fastmail's own apps and has no snooze, scheduled send or support for your own domain.

At checkout for Individual on 1 month we would pay €6 today, including €1.04 VAT. The plan renews automatically on 11/30/2026 and Fastmail gives no refunds for unused time. We stopped before the payment step.
When we clicked New user, Fastmail first asked for a mobile number to text a code to, and said the number is also needed to send your first message. The account address is hidden.
Export sits under Settings, Migration, with Download all contacts. The vCard file we got left out both groups we had given each contact.
We edited that vCard and imported it again. Fastmail added copies instead of updating our contacts, so each test contact now appears twice.
